'''Red Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadron that flew for the newly-formed [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] in the late stages of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. During the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar]] at the end of the war, Red Squadron was tasked with defending [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]] from the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] ship that had been infected with the [[Alpha Red (pathogen)|Alpha Red virus]].<ref name="TUF" />
